label: PF Backlog 521
title: Defect/RCCA: multi_model_review.review enforces majority only (no quorum) - single model can PASS; quorum test RED
body:
## Problem / why
core/multi_model_review.review passed on a MAJORITY only, so a SINGLE reviewer returning pass -> passed=True.
result_aggregator enforces a quorum (>=2; a single contribution can never pass) and its test
(test_result_aggregator::test_multi_model_review_quorum_bug_fixed) is RED on develop - found by precheck --full.

## Acceptance criteria
- review() enforces a quorum (PF_MULTI_REVIEW_QUORUM, default 2) AND a strict majority; a single pass never passes.
- test_result_aggregator (quorum test) passes.

## In scope
Add the quorum to multi_model_review.review.

## Out of scope
result_aggregator (already correct).

## Verification
10 tests in test_result_aggregator pass.
